doc.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005

title: Jimmy Aldridge and saving for retirement
summary: Mentions Ron Aldridge and his father at WINS, and the life insurance he had to drop.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Yeah. You’ve heard of Ron Aldridge? He’s a famous dentist and a great jazz clarinet player? Ron Aldridge. He plays very much like Buddy DeFranco. Well his father was a cellist and saxophone player with me at WINS at the time.
Yeah. Jimmy Aldridge. I remember Ron when he was just born.
Did you have in those days, were you thinking about putting money aside for your retirement and all that.

Yeah. I forget the insurance company at the moment, yeah Chicaine. Yeah I was putting in oh so much. I had my family, I had 50 thousand dollars on my life. And then after many, many years I gave it up. I couldn’t afford to pay it anymore. I was spending too much.
